name: Nacos Toolkit
description: Connect to Nacos from DBX and expose read-only MCP tools to AI agents: get, search, diff and inspect config history, plus namespaces, services and instances.

contributions.label: Nacos Toolkit
contributions.description: Connect to a Nacos server to browse configs and expose read-only tools to the MCP server.

fields.label: Context path
fields.description: Change only when Nacos is deployed under a custom context path.

fields.label: Console port
fields.description: Nacos 3.x console port (default 8080, auto-detected when empty). Leave empty for Nacos 1.x/2.x.

fields.label: API version
fields.description: auto (default, recommended), v1 or v3. Override only when auto-detection picks the wrong protocol stack.

fields.label: Namespace ID
fields.description: Namespace used for config and service queries. Leave empty for the public namespace.

fields.label: Username
fields.description: Leave empty when the Nacos server has authentication disabled.

contributions.label: Nacos Toolkit
contributions.description: Connection status and the read-only tools this plugin exposes to AI agents.
Read-only Nacos tools: get/search/diff configs and history, list namespaces, services and instances.

zh-CN.name: Nacos 工具箱
zh-CN.description: 在 DBX 中连接 Nacos，并向 AI 助手开放只读 MCP 工具：读配置、搜索配置、跨环境对比、配置历史，以及命名空间、服务与实例列表。

io.github.ct17.nacos_toolkit.connection.label: Nacos 工具箱
io.github.ct17.nacos_toolkit.connection.description: 连接 Nacos 服务器，浏览配置并向 AI 开放只读工具。

context_path.label: Context Path
context_path.description: 仅当 Nacos 部署在自定义 context path 下时修改。

console_port.label: Console 端口
console_port.description: Nacos 3.x 的控制台端口（默认 8080，留空时自动探测）；1.x/2.x 可留空。

api_version.label: API 版本
api_version.description: auto（默认，推荐）/ v1 / v3；仅在自动探测选错协议栈时需要手动指定。

namespace.label: 命名空间 ID
namespace.description: 配置与服务查询使用的命名空间，留空表示 public。

username.label: 用户名
username.description: Nacos 未开启鉴权时留空。

io.github.ct17.nacos_toolkit.workbench.label: Nacos 工具箱
io.github.ct17.nacos_toolkit.workbench.description: 连接状态以及本插件向 AI 助手开放的只读工具。
